title: The Brave girl from the next street
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：brave　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 brave 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the driver wrote of ① a brave girl from the next street in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② braver than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the brave ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the bravest girl from the next street anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1956 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too brave to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the brave ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a brave decision to stay, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as brave as the decision to stay they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was brave or not, and he said so.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something brave, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite brave; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the brave ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972, twice over, she wrote of another brave girl from the next street in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ braver than anybody had expected. ⑩ The bravest decision to stay in the whole station, she said in 1974, was the one she could never quite name; the brave ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 勇敢（前置定语 a brave girl from the next street：1962 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件勇敢的女孩）
B. adj. 勇敢／无畏（比较级 braver than：文中两处，一处比邻街的女孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 勇敢／无畏（最高级 the bravest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 勇敢（表语 too brave to do：母亲觉得它太勇敢，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 无畏（前置定语 a brave decision to stay：叔叔把整件事称作一桩无畏的决定）
F. adj. 无畏（同级比较 as brave as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩留下的决定相比）
G. adj. 无畏（后置定语 something brave：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 无畏（受程度副词修饰 quite brave：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a brave girl from the next street
the bravest girl from the next street anybody
The bravest decision to stay in

answers.why: brave 意为“勇敢”，1962 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件勇敢的女孩”，此处作前置定语 a brave girl from the next street。
brave 意为“勇敢”，此处用比较级 braver than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
brave 意为“勇敢”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最勇敢的一件，故用最高级 the bravest girl from the next street。
brave 意为“勇敢”，母亲认为这件东西“太勇敢了，谁也用不上”，too brave to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
brave 意为“无畏”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩无畏的决定”，此处作前置定语 a brave decision to stay。
brave 意为“无畏”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩留下的决定一样无畏”，同级比较用 as brave as。
brave 意为“无畏”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“无畏的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something brave。
brave 意为“无畏”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当无畏”，quite 修饰原级 brave。
brave 意为“无畏”，1972 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要无畏”，故用比较级 braver than。
brave 意为“无畏”，母亲 1974 年说的是“整个车站里最无畏的那一桩”，故用最高级 the bravest decision to stay。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件勇敢的女孩。（a brave girl from the next street）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更勇敢。（braver than …）
母亲觉得它太勇敢，谁也用不上。（too brave to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩无畏的决定。（a brave decision to stay）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩留下的决定一样无畏。（as brave as …）
到了 1969 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件无畏的东西。（something brave）
answers: In 1962 the driver wrote of a brave girl from the next street in the timetable.
Everybody said it was braver than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too brave to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a brave decision to stay.
He said nobody would call it as brave as the decision to stay they had once had.
By 1969 the timetable asked for nothing but something brave.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 brave 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the driver wrote of a brave girl from the next street in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the bravest girl from the next street in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too brave to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a brave decision to stay, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite brave, and everybody laughed.
The brave ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
